resources.name: Molecular dynamics engine (GROMACS, LAMMPS, or NAMD)

access.notes: Any recent version of an open-source MD package that supports SPC/E water, standard Lennard-Jones parameters, periodic boundary conditions, Ewald summation, and rigid-body dynamics is acceptable.
Standard SPC/E parameters are included in most MD packages or can be obtained from literature (e.g., Berendsen et al., J. Phys. Chem. 1987).
Standard O2 Lennard-Jones parameters are available from OPLS-AA or other general force fields. The qualitative trends emerge with a standard 12-6 LJ O2–water interaction.
